Iraq in the 1139-1201 shapes left as drawn although the Seljuk Empire page says Iraq stayed Seljuk until 1135
Fars in 1046-1062 and the eastern edge at 70.6-73.95 E in 1066-1146 left as drawn
Gulf coast and Bahrain (Malik-Shah's 1075 army against the Qarmatians) not coded
Six keyframe verdicts (1056, 1072, 1139, 1147, 1152, 1188) are ok only because no opened page contradicts them
Merv and the Turkmen plains in 1152-1179 left as drawn; the pages show Sultan-Shah holding Merv by 1180 but not who held it before
Dihistan (Tekish captured it after pursuing Sultan-Shah) is undated
The 1199 Assassin campaign is not coded (Qahira has no location on the page); Qara Khitai suzerainty 1141-1156 left to the kara-khitans ledger
Kayseri in 1099-1145 left as drawn; the pages show it Danishmend only by 1146
The 1142 division of Mehmed's lands among brothers (Sivas, Malatya, Kayseri-Elbistan) is not coded as separate states, and the lands of the 1177 remnant are not given
Yagibasan's Byzantine vassalage (c. 1146-1150) and Danishmend help to Mesud I at Konya in 1116 not coded
Battle of Melitene (1100) page not opened; the 1100-1101 events rest on the Danishmendids and Malatya pages

problems: seljuk-dynasty (Cliopatria 990-1039) and great-seljuk-empire (1040-1201) are the same Seljuk state on the Seljuk Empire page (formation 1037); kept apart because Cliopatria does, a reviewer may merge them with a rename event.
khwarezmid-dynasty (Q486918, 1077-1201) and khwarezmid-empire (Q63134381, 1202-1235) are one line of shahs; the dossiers name each other, a reviewer may merge.
great-seljuk-empire names the successor slug 'eldiguzids', which has no polity row and no dossier (the validator does not check successors); khwarezmid-empire and shaddadids also mention it.
great-seljuk-empire carries 2 validator warnings, both for the counterpart slug 'kerman-seljuk-sultanate', which has no dossier yet.

Cliopatria rows run past the pages' end years: Great Seljuk to 1201 against the page's March 1194; Danishmendids to 1187 against 1178. The keyframes cut them at the page dates; the Great Seljuk tail 1195-1201 is coded as Khwarezmid in khwarezmid-dynasty.
Cliopatria rows start late: Seljuk Dynasty 990 against 985; Danishmendids 1094 against 1075; Khwarezmid Dynasty 1094 against 1077. New early keyframes were added.

Page disagreements, kept in the event notes: Malatya taken 1101 (Malatya page) against 1103 (Danishmendids page); Khorasan to the Ghurids 1192 (Sanjar page) against 1200 (Seljuk Empire page); Isfahan as capital 1051 (infobox) against Tughril's entry in 1052; Alp Arslan's death 24 November against 15 December 1072; Hazarasp 1138 (Sanjar page) against 1204 (Anushtegin page); Seljuk dynasty page keeps Cend as seat to 1037 while also having Tughril leave it in 1016.
Verdict 'ok' on 12 shapes (seljuk-dynasty 2, great-seljuk-empire 6, danishmendids 4) means no opened page contradicts the shape (page budget), not that a page confirms it.
Native names in identity are from general knowledge, not from a page opened; December 1055 (Baghdad) was converted from a Hijri date by me; Cend capital coordinates are approximate.
